LeiKwan Bridge bundles sing-box as an independent helper.

Project: https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box
Documentation: https://sing-box.sagernet.org/
License: GNU General Public License version 3 (GPL-3.0-only)

The bundled helper is not linked into the LeiKwan Bridge application. Source is
available from the project URL above at the version pinned by the build script.
The helper may be replaced or removed without modifying this application.
